Class Workflow.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.workflow.Workflow.Builder
Enclosing class:
Workflow
public static final class Workflow.Builder extends Object
Builder for Workflow. Only the name is required. Unlike other nodes, a workflow reruns from scratch when resumed unless rerunOnResume turns that off.
